user.title: Set up YoDeck
user.description:
Enter your YoDeck API token to connect your schedules to Home Assistant.

Update Interval: How often to fetch data (in seconds). Default is 3600 (60 minutes). Minimum is 300 (5 minutes).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token. Please check your token and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to YoDeck API. Please check your internet connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.scan_interval_too_low: Scan interval must be at least {min_interval} minutes to respect API rate limits.

abort.already_configured: This YoDeck account is already configured.

init.title: YoDeck Options
init.description:
Configure how often to fetch data from YoDeck API.

⚠️ Warning: Setting this too low may hit rate limits. Minimum: {min_interval} minutes. Default: {default_interval} minutes.

Schedules don't change frequently, so a longer interval is recommended.

error.scan_interval_too_low: Scan interval must be at least {min_interval} minutes (300 seconds) to respect API rate limits.
